entities.summary: Włoszczowa is a town in southern Poland, in Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship. It lies approximately 50 kilometres west of Kielce. It is the capital of Włoszczowa County. Population is 10,657 (2010). Włoszczowa lies in historic Lesser Poland. The town has the area of 30 km2 (12 sq mi).
